generic_export.title: Export YAML template
generic_export.description: Device: {device}. Writes a normal Modbus Manager template (same unique_id suffixes) to config/modbus_manager/templates/. Download is a signed link in the notification (valid 1 hour).

menu_options.generic_export_close: Done — YAML written. Download YAML in the notification (link valid 1 hour).
